name: Teaser
description: Polymorphic record teaser: lists records of any active record type (Property, ...) in one of five Figma layouts — cards, cards-compact, list, feature, or edge. Records are picked manually via relation fields or queried automatically from a storage folder with filter, limit, and order; each record renders through its record type's card component.
when_to_use: Reference/portfolio rows fed by structured records — 'Unsere Referenzen', latest properties. Use Blocks or News for hand-authored inline items instead of records.
capabilities: five layout variants: cards (one paged row of 4), cards-compact (paged row of 2), list (horizontal rows), feature (lead card + thumbnails that switch it), edge (horizontal breakout track)
Figma Columns axis: columns = 3 gives a three-card row on cards
record source per active record type (dropdown driven by factory.json active_record_types)
manual record picking or auto query (storage folder, listing-type filter, limit, order)
header: eyebrow (+ decoration, accent color), title, intro, text-link(s) bottom-right
card part switches handed to every record card: show_image, show_category, show_address, show_divider, show_meta; card text link (card_link_label) on list/feature
show_pager (arrows; off = every card, wrapped), show_thumbnails (feature)
optional centred band button below the records (band_button_label / band_button_to)

variants.description: One row of 4 bordered cards (3 with columns = 3); extra cards page with the arrows. Default.
One row of 2 larger cards (16:9 image, larger title); pages like cards.
Horizontal rows: image left, tag/title/address, meta, card text link.
A lead card (large title, card text link) plus a thumbnail list that switches it.
Horizontal slider whose track extends past the right container edge; arrows sit in the header row.

breakpoints.mobile: ≤640: one card per view with a peek; list rows stack their info beside a 96px image; feature stacks with a scrolling thumb row; edge cards 280.
breakpoints.tablet: ≤1024: cards/cards-compact two per view; feature stacks; edge cards 380.
breakpoints.desktop: Full variant layout (4/2/3 per row, feature 1.6 : 1, edge cards 460).

figma.portReason: Rebuilt on the spec node names (teaser-*, rcard-*) with token values; paging is a native scroll-snap track instead of a slider library.

lbl.none: fixed meta labels (Fläche / Einh. / Jahr); drawn by the record card

val.none: unsure: meta cells vary per card (area / units / year as formatted text), no stable index to area_m2 / units / year_completed

eyebrow-text.none: covered by the Eyebrow content key

h-1.none: covered by the Headline content key

body-text.none: covered by the Intro content key

btn-label.none: covered by the Band Button content key

ai.prompt_summary: Teaser: polymorphic record listing. Settings: variant (cards|cards-compact|list|feature|edge, matching Figma), columns (auto|3). Header: eyebrow, eyebrow_decoration (none|bar|dot), eyebrow_color (7 semantic tokens), title, description, text_align (left|center|right), buttons[] (rendered as text links, typically one 'Alle anzeigen'); band_button_label + band_button_to (one centred outline button below the records, empty = off). Card switches (checkbox, default 1): show_image, show_category, show_address, show_divider, show_meta; card_link_label (list/feature card link, '' = none). show_pager (arrows; 0 = all cards wrapped), show_thumbnails (feature). Overrides: content_align (default|left|center), heading_case (default|upper), heading_weight (default|light|bold). Source: record_type (dynamic, from active_record_types), selection_mode (manual|auto); manual: records (one picker covering every record type); auto: auto_storage_pid (folder, empty = all), auto_filter_listing_type (''|buy|rent), auto_limit (default 6), auto_order ('crdate desc'|'crdate asc'|'title asc').
ai.content_guidelines: Header title short; one text link 'Alle anzeigen' at most. 4-8 records; auto mode with a limit is the common default. Switch card parts off with the show_* checkboxes rather than leaving record fields empty.

field_hints.variant: Layout family; the record card interior is owned by the record type's card component.
field_hints.record_type: Options come from factory.json active_record_types at runtime — not a fixed list.
field_hints.auto_storage_pid: Page/folder holding the records; leave empty to query all locations.
field_hints.records: Only read in manual mode. A CSV of record UIDs; the picker is restricted to the active record tables.
field_hints.band_button_label: The Figma "Band Button": a single call to action under the cards (e.g. "Alle Referenzen ansehen"). Leave empty when the design has none.
field_hints.columns: Figma's Columns axis: '3' renders three cards per row on cards; auto keeps the variant's count.
field_hints.card_link_label: Card text link on list ('Details') and feature ('Zum Projekt'). Empty = no card link.
field_hints.show_pager: 0 removes the arrows and shows every record, wrapped into rows.
field_hints.content_align: Design override: center centres the header block; default keeps text_align.

renamed_fields.note: One generic picker replaced the per-type records_<slug> columns: Content Blocks creates columns from config.yaml, so the promised per-type TCA pass had no column behind it (DL #030). `allowed` is now built from every discovered record table.
